subject: Coord: contract redlines + joint engineering sync
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Intro + proposed joint session for redlines and tech review

Samir —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, it sounds like two things would help move this to signature: a short joint tech sync with your engineering team to confirm integration points, and then a redline walkthrough with procurement + legal so we can close outstanding contract edits.

Proposed plan:
- Technical sync (AE + SE + Acme engineers) — 45 minutes
- Contract redline meeting (AE + Legal + Procurement + Redwood legal as needed) — 30 minutes

Are you available for the tech sync Tuesday or Wednesday morning PT? If those work, I can coordinate the redline slot the same week so your legal/procurement momentum stays intact. Evelyn (cc'd) will lead the technical portion.

Attaching the latest redline (Acme_Redline_v2.pdf) and a stub SOC2 evidence bundle for procurement.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Acme_Redline_v2.pdf, SOC2-evidence-stub.pdf

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-industries.com>

Cc: Jenna Morales <jenna.morales@acme-industries.com>, Alex Kim <alex.kim@acme-legal.com>, procurement@acme-industries.com
Date: 2026-02-18T09:46:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed joint session for redlines and tech review

Connor — thanks for the clear plan.

Tuesday morning PT is tricky for our infra folks. Wednesday 10:00–11:00 PT would work for engineering (Jenna will join). For the redline meeting, procurement prefers a separate 30-minute block later that day so they can include our CISO and head of procurement. Would 15:30–16:00 PT on Wednesday work for Redwood legal + our legal and procurement?

Also looping in Alex (Acme legal) — Alex, any conflicts with the proposed redline window?

Samir
Senior PM, Integrations | Acme Industries

Connor — I can make the 15:30–16:00 PT slot on Wednesday. Two quick asks before the redline: please share the current redline in PDF and a short summary of any non-standard clauses we should focus on (data residency, indemnity caps, SLA credits). That will help me prep and avoid a long back-and-forth in the meeting.

Thanks,

Samir / Jenna — Wednesday 10:00–11:00 PT works for me for the technical sync. I plan to cover:
- High-level architecture and how we handle network egress + VPC peering
- Key integration touchpoints (API auth, rate limits, retries)
- KV cache behavior for long-running sessions

Connor — for the redline meeting, if procurement or legal wants Redwood legal on the call, please let me know. I've copied Aditya for pricing/contract scope questions he may need to clear.

Also attached a short SOC2 evidence stub for procurement.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redlines

Connor

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-02-20T16:45:00-05:00
Subject: FYI: escalation path / approval for concessions on RINF-3291

Connor / Aditya —

Quick note after reviewing the thread and the proposed redlines: if the customer presses for a material change to indemnity limits or a multi-year pricing concession, escalate to me before verbal commitment. Happy to approve exceptional concessions but want to review the final language and economics first.

If the redline meeting on Wednesday surfaces only routine items (SLA credits, minor wording tweaks), feel free to complete the iteration without me. Please flag anything substantial and include a short one-paragraph summary of the ask in your email so I can respond quickly.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
